title: “All My Life” by Lil Durk featuring J. Cole
text: "All My Life" is a song by American rapper Lil Durk featuring fellow American rapper J. Cole. It was released through Only the Family, Alamo Records, and Sony Music as the lead single from the former's eighth studio album, Almost Healed, on May 12, 2023.
listen: All My Life Lil Durk featuring J. Cole

title: “Ella Baila Sola” by Eslabon Armado and Peso Pluma
text: "Ella Baila Sola" is a song by the American regional Mexican group Eslabón Armado and Mexican singer Peso Pluma. It was released on March 17, 2023, through DEL Records and Prajin Parlay, as the lead single for the group's album Desvelado (2023).
listen: Ella Baila Sola Eslabon Armado and Peso Pluma

title: “Karma” by Taylor Swift featuring Ice Spice
text: "Karma" is a song by the American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift from her tenth studio album, Midnights. The song was written and produced by Swift, Jack Antonoff, Sounwave, and Keanu Beats; Jahaan Sweet was a co-writer.
listen: Karma Taylor Swift featuring Ice Spice

title: “Just Wanna Rock” by Lil Uzi Vert
text: "Just Wanna Rock" is a song by American rapper Lil Uzi Vert. It was released as the lead single for their third studio album, Pink Tape, through Atlantic Records and Generation Now on October 17, 2022.
listen: Just Wanna Rock Lil Uzi Vert

title: “Cuff It” by Beyoncé
text: "Cuff It" is a song by American singer Beyoncé from her seventh studio album, Renaissance. It was released as the album's second single on September 30, 2022, through Parkwood Entertainment and Columbia Records.

title: “Vampire” by Olivia Rodrigo
text: "Vampire" is a song by American singer-songwriter Olivia Rodrigo. Geffen and Interscope Records released it on June 30, 2023, as the lead single from her second studio album, Guts (2023).

title: “FukUMean” by Gunna
text: "FukUMean" (stylized in lowercase letters and pronounced "fuck you mean") is a song by American rapper Gunna. It was sent to rhythmic contemporary radio through YSL Records and 300 Entertainment as the second and final single from his fourth studio album, A Gift & a Curse, on July 11, 2023.

title: “Lavender Haze” by Taylor Swift
text: "Lavender Haze" is a song by the American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift from her tenth studio album, Midnights. Swift wrote and produced the song with Jack Antonoff, Jahaan Sweet, and Sounwave.

title: “Players” by Coi Leray
text: "Players" is a song by American rapper and singer Coi Leray. It was released on November 30, 2022, through Republic Records and 1801 as the lead single from her second studio album, Coi.

title: “Need a Favor” by Jelly Roll
text: "Need a Favor" is a song by American musician Jelly Roll, released on December 9, 2022, as the lead single from his ninth studio album Whitsitt Chapel. Jelly Roll co-wrote the song with Rob Ragosta, Joe Ragosta and Austin Nivarel, the latter of whom produced it.

title: “Dance the Night” by Dua Lipa
text: "Dance the Night" is a song by English singer Dua Lipa from the soundtrack to the fantasy comedy film Barbie. Lipa co-wrote the song with songwriter Caroline Ailin and its producers Andrew Wyatt and Mark Ronson; the Picard Brothers also contributed to production.

title: “Love You Anyway” by Luke Combs
text: "Love You Anyway" is a song by American country music singer Luke Combs. It released on February 10, 2023, as the lead single from his fourth studio album Gettin' Old.

title: “One Thing at a Time” by Morgan Wallen
text: "One Thing at a Time" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music singer Morgan Wallen. Wallen wrote the song with Ashley Gorley, Ernest Keith Smith, and Ryan Vojtesak, and it was produced by Joey Moi.
listen: One Thing at a Time Morgan Wallen

title: “Superhero (Heroes & Villains)” by Metro Boomin, Future and Chris Brown
text: "Superhero" is a song by American record producer Metro Boomin, American rapper Future, and American singer Chris Brown, released as the title track from the former's second studio album Heroes & Villains (2022). Co-produced by Allen Ritter and David X Eli, it peaked at number 8 on the Billboard Hot 100.
listen: Superhero (Heroes & Villains) Metro Boomin, Future and Chris Brown

title: “Bad Habit” by Steve Lacy
text: "Bad Habit" is a song recorded by the American musician Steve Lacy. It was the second released single from his second studio album, Gemini Rights, on June 29, 2022.

title: “La Bebé” by Yng Lvcas and Peso Pluma
text: "La Bebé" is a song by Mexican singer Yng Lvcas, released as first single from his second mixtape LPM on 24 December 2021, same day of the release of the mixtape.
listen: La Bebé Yng Lvcas and Peso Pluma

title: “Golden Hour” by Jvke
text: "Golden Hour" is a song by American singer-songwriter Jvke. Released as a single on July 15, 2022, it went viral on TikTok later in the year and became an international hit.

title: “Religiously” by Bailey Zimmerman
text: "Religiously" is a song by American country music singer Bailey Zimmerman. It was released on March 17, 2023 as the third single from his debut studio album Religiously.

title: “Spin Bout U” by Drake and 21 Savage
text: "Spin Bout U" is a song by Canadian rapper Drake and Atlanta-based rapper 21 Savage from their collaborative studio album Her Loss. It was sent to US rhythmic radio on February 24, 2023, as the third single from the album alongside a music video.
listen: Spin Bout U Drake and 21 Savage

title: “Cupid” by Fifty Fifty
text: "Cupid" is a song recorded by South Korean girl group Fifty Fifty. It was released as The Beginning: Cupid, a single album featuring a Korean version, an English version sung by group members Sio and Aran, and an instrumental version of the song, on February 24, 2023, through Attrakt.

title: “Search & Rescue” by Drake
text: "Search & Rescue" is a song by Canadian rapper Drake. It was released through OVO Sound and Republic Records as a single on April 7, 2023.

title: “Barbie World” by Nicki Minaj and Ice Spice with Aqua
text: "Barbie World" is a song by rappers Nicki Minaj and Ice Spice from Barbie the Album, the soundtrack of the film Barbie. It was released by Atlantic Records, 10K Projects, and Capitol Records as the soundtrack's third single on June 23, 2023.
listen: Barbie World Nicki Minaj and Ice Spice with Aqua

title: “Next Thing You Know” by Jordan Davis
text: "Next Thing You Know" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music singer Jordan Davis. It was released on August 12, 2022, as the third single from his second studio album Bluebird Days.
listen: Next Thing You Know Jordan Davis

title: “Escapism” by Raye featuring 070 Shake
text: "Escapism." is a song by the British singer-songwriter Raye featuring the American rapper 070 Shake. It was released independently through Human Re Sources on 12 October 2022, as the third single from Raye's debut studio album, My 21st Century Blues, and as a dual single with "The Thrill Is Gone".

title: “Un x100to” by Grupo Frontera and Bad Bunny
text: "Un x100to" is a song by the American band Grupo Frontera and Puerto Rican rapper Bad Bunny. It was released on April 17, 2023, through Rimas.
listen: Un x100to Grupo Frontera and Bad Bunny

title: “Until I Found You” by Stephen Sanchez
text: "Until I Found You" is the breakout single of American singer-songwriter Stephen Sanchez. It was released on September 1, 2021, as the lead single from Sanchez's second extended play Easy on My Eyes and debut album Angel Face.
listen: Until I Found You Stephen Sanchez

title: “Shirt” by SZA
text: "Shirt" is a song by American singer-songwriter SZA and the third single from her second studio album, SOS. Produced by Darkchild and Freaky Rob, it is an R&B song, with elements of trap music, backed by synthesizers and 808 beats.

title: “Paint the Town Red” by Doja Cat
text: "Paint the Town Red" is a song by American rapper and singer Doja Cat from her fourth studio album, Scarlet. It was released on August 4, 2023, through Kemosabe and RCA Records as the lead single from the album.
wiki: Paint the Town Red (Doja Cat song)
listen: Paint the Town Red Doja Cat

title: “Made You Look” by Meghan Trainor
text: "Made You Look" is a song by the American singer-songwriter Meghan Trainor from her fifth major-label studio album, Takin' It Back. Trainor wrote it with songwriter Sean Douglas and its producer, Federico Vindver.

title: “Wait in the Truck” by Hardy featuring Lainey Wilson
text: "Wait in the Truck" is a song by American country music singer Hardy featuring American country music singer Lainey Wilson. It was released on August 29, 2022, as the lead single from Hardy's second studio album The Mockingbird & the Crow.
listen: Wait in the Truck Hardy featuring Lainey Wilson

title: “All I Want for Christmas Is You” by Mariah Carey
text: "All I Want for Christmas Is You" is a song by American singer-songwriter Mariah Carey from her fourth studio album and first holiday album, Merry Christmas. She wrote and produced the song with Walter Afanasieff.
wiki: All I Want for Christmas Is You
listen: All I Want for Christmas Is You Mariah Carey

title: “Everything I Love” by Morgan Wallen
text: "Everything I Love" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music singer Morgan Wallen. It was released on June 26, 2023, as the fifth single from his third studio album One Thing at a Time.

title: “Chemical” by Post Malone
text: "Chemical" is a song by American musician Post Malone. It was released through Republic and Mercury Records as the lead single from his fifth studio album, Austin, on April 14, 2023.

title: “Heart Like a Truck” by Lainey Wilson
text: "Heart Like a Truck" is a song recorded by American country music singer Lainey Wilson. It was released in May 2022 as the lead single from her third studio album, Bell Bottom Country.
listen: Heart Like a Truck Lainey Wilson

title: “Going, Going, Gone” by Luke Combs
text: "Going, Going, Gone" is a song by American country music singer Luke Combs. It was released on October 24, 2022 as the third single from his third studio album Growin' Up.

title: “Rockin' Around the Christmas Tree” by Brenda Lee
text: "Rockin' Around the Christmas Tree" is a Christmas song written by Johnny Marks and recorded by Brenda Lee in 1958; it has since been recorded by numerous other music artists. By the song's 50th anniversary in 2008, Lee's original version had sold over 15 million copies around the world with the 4th most digital downloads sold of any Christmas single.
listen: Rockin' Around the Christmas Tree Brenda Lee

title: “Dancin' in the Country” by Tyler Hubbard
text: "Dancin' in the Country" is a song by American country music singer Tyler Hubbard. It was released on November 21, 2022 as the second single from Hubbard's self-titled debut studio album.
listen: Dancin' in the Country Tyler Hubbard

title: “Daylight” by David Kushner
text: "Daylight" is a song by the American singer-songwriter David Kushner. Kushner wrote it with Hayden Robert Hubers, Jeremy Fedryk, Josh Bruce Williams, and Drake Jon Livingston Jr., and Rob Kirwan produced it.

title: “Lift Me Up” by Rihanna
text: "Lift Me Up" is a song recorded by the Barbadian singer Rihanna. It was released on October 28, 2022, by Westbury Road, Roc Nation, Def Jam, and Hollywood Records, as the lead single from the soundtrack album of the 2022 superhero film Black Panther: Wakanda Forever.

title: “Eyes Closed” by Ed Sheeran
text: "Eyes Closed" is a song by English singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran. It was released on 24 March 2023 through Asylum and Atlantic Records as the lead single from his fifth studio album, −.
